mapper.insert: INSERT INTO scm_supplier_contact (contact_id, tenant_id, supplier_id, name, role, email, phone, primary_contact, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{contactId}, #{tenantId}, #{supplierId}, #{name}, #{role}, #{email}, #{phone}, #{primaryContact}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM scm_supplier_contact WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND supplier_id = #{supplierId}
mapper.select: SELECT contact_id, tenant_id, supplier_id, name, role, email, phone, primary_contact, created_at, updated_at FROM scm_supplier_contact WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND supplier_id = #{supplierId} ORDER BY primary_contact DESC, created_at DESC
